user.say: Hi, I have an AC servicing appointment booked and I'd like to move it to Saturday morning if possible.
That works for me, 2:00 PM on Saturday is fine.

steps.text: I'll pull up your bookings to find the AC servicing appointment.
Found it — AC servicing with Ravi Aircon Experts. Let me check what slots are free that Saturday morning.
Saturday morning has one open slot — 8:00 to 9:00 AM with the same provider. Let me put that up for approval.

The reschedule card is on screen — moving your AC servicing (Ravi Aircon Experts, ₹999) from Monday 9 Nov 11:00 AM to Saturday 7 Nov 8:00 AM. Please check the card and tap Approve if it looks right; nothing moves until you do.

Nothing moved — the 8:00 AM Saturday slot was taken before the tap went through. A new card is on screen offering Saturday 7 Nov at 2:00 PM with the same provider and price; the other free Saturday slots are 3:00 PM and 6:00 PM.

Do you want to tap Approve on the 2:00 PM card, or would you rather pick one of the later slots?

Nothing is changed yet — a typed "yes" doesn't approve the move, only a tap on the card's Approve button does. The 2:00 PM Saturday card is shown again; please tap Approve ₹999 on it and the move will go through.
Moved — your AC servicing with Ravi Aircon Experts is now Saturday, 7 Nov at 2:00 PM IST (was Monday, 9 Nov at 11:00 AM). Booking ID bkg_seed_3.
